dbPath.label: Database Path
dbPath.help: Path to the Cortex SQLite database (default: ~/.cortex/memory.db)

binaryPath.label: Binary Path
binaryPath.help: Path to cortex-mcp-server binary (default: looks in PATH, then ~/.local/bin/)

autoCapture.label: Auto-Capture
autoCapture.help: Automatically store conversation context after each agent turn

autoRecall.label: Auto-Recall
autoRecall.help: Automatically inject relevant memories before each agent turn

topK.label: Top K Results
topK.help: Maximum number of memories to retrieve (default: 10)
